title: [TRACKER] HDR output issues & PRs
body:
This is a tracker for all issues and PRs relating to the upcoming [HDR ouput feature](https://github.com/godotengine/godot-proposals/issues/10817).

- Sibling tracker: https://github.com/godotengine/godot-proposals/issues/13750

### Base HDR output implementation

- [x] #94496

### Other items without issues or PRs
- [x] [Environment color_correction docs need to be marked as SDR only](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/94496/changes#r2796615969).
- [ ] `ColorPicker` does not support HDR output
- [x] Windows luminance polling may be further optimized(?)
   - Ideally we would use WinRT interop to get AdvancedColor events when these properties change, ~but we believe that's currently not possible with how Godot is built with MinGW. [Notes about this here](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/94496#issuecomment-3932767813)~ https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/118339.
   - This was discussed in [this thread](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/94496#discussion_r2737357516)
   - Attempts for other optimizations have been made and [described here](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/94496#issuecomment-3881605335).
- [ ] Sun of procedural sky looks dim in HDR. Probably also the case when using a tonemapper with `white > 1.0`. See [comment here](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/113292#issuecomment-3619559928).
- [ ] Add warnings when SDR-only Environment features are used with HDR output.
   - [Calinou suggested this in a comment](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/106814#pullrequestreview-3787744802).
- [ ] Movie Maker does not support HDR recording
- [ ] Manually set maximum luminance applies to all screens instead of being applied as a per-screen setting (moving window between displays results in incorrect max luminance if it was manually set)
